# Xplania — full description

> Xplania (https://xplania.app) is a web app, in French and English, that helps people going abroad organise their trip ahead of time, without hassle. During the beta it focuses on one need: preparing the departure. All AI advice is specific to the destination, never generic.

## How it works

1. Create an account (free during the beta).
2. Enter the trip: destination, dates or length of stay, nationality, approximate budget and type of stay (Erasmus/exchange, internship, trip).
3. Prepare with the four tools below; a dashboard shows progress in each one and an email reminder is sent 7 days before departure.

## The four preparation tools

- Budget guide (/guide-budget): realistic budget for the destination and length of stay in 3 scenarios (economy, realistic, comfort), planned-expense tracking with charts, saving tips, PDF export.
- Visa & paperwork guide (/guide-visa): visa formalities for the traveler's nationality, recommended vaccines and safety advice summarized from official sources (France Diplomatie, Institut Pasteur, WHO), with a document checklist. Always check official sites before travelling.
- Packing list (/guide-valise): checklist adapted to the destination's weather, the length and the type of stay, outfit ideas and missing-item check.
- Culture guide (/guide-culture): cultural codes of the destination country — dress, food and table manners, gestures, greetings — with real-life situations, a tip of the day and a mini-quiz. Ready-made sheets for 10 countries; other countries are written by AI on demand.

Ping, Xplania's assistant, answers questions about these four topics only.

## Access

- Beta: free, no card required, up to 10 AI generations per tool per month (a failed generation is given back).
- Post-beta offers: not set yet.

## Privacy

No resale of data, account and data can be deleted anytime. Details on /securite and /politique-de-confidentialite.
